AR-2026S1-HB1001.aiSummary: This act lowers Arkansas income tax rates for individuals, trusts, and estates for tax years starting on or after January 1, 2026. It also sets new corporate income tax rates for Arkansas and foreign corporations for tax years starting on or after January 1, 2027, with rates of 1%, 2%, 3%, and 4.1% based on income levels.

AR-2026F-SR34.aiSummary: The Arkansas Senate resolution would recognize the Arkansas Tech University Golden Suns women’s cross country team for winning the Great American Conference Championship. AR-2026F-SR16.aiSummary: This resolution would let a senator introduce a bill about the Arkansas Children’s Educational Freedom Account Program. The planned bill would change how much money students get each year, add test score rules for keeping the account, bar some private school students from getting an account, and add some reporting duties for service providers who work with homeschooled students. It would also change the annual testing rules for students in the program.

AR-2026F-HB1023.aiSummary: This measure makes funding for the Arkansas Department of Human Services Secretary’s Office for fiscal year 2026-2027. It sets money for staff pay, extra help, office costs, data services, and building work, including $69,893,961 for operations and $15,914,729 for construction. It also sets the largest number of regular jobs and temporary help the office may use. The bill passed the legislature and was sent to the governor.
